'''WJ-880 blinding helmet''' was a helmet used during [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] of [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentices]]. Covering the wearer's eyes, it prompted them to rely on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to perceive their surroundings. When he was still an apprentice, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was known to have worn such a helmet in conjunction with a Jedi training suit.<ref name="Training gear2">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Obi-Wan Kenobi (Jedi Training Gear)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/POTJobiwanjt.asp}}</ref>
